description: data/ui/active_font.json (UH-Font-A): the single pointer to the game-wide custom font family, orthogonal to the existing 7-preset size/bold system (data/ui/fonts.json). 'default' means today's pygame.font.SysFont('monospace', ...) behavior; any other value must match an entry id in data/fonts/font_manifest.json - a cross-file check a schema can't express, so game/main.py's boot loader cross-checks it and fails loud (D-2, the engine.tilemap.load_map precedent). Written ONLY by the editor's Theme panel, through the validating writer.

font_id.description: 'default' for the system monospace fallback, else a data/fonts/font_manifest.json entry id.

title: active_font
